notes:
Topline: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building conversational support and semantic search in product UI. Started with Hosted API POC (Nov 2025) -> now moving to Dedicated for cost predictability and residency.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-10: initial intro demo (Jordan, Priya) — product fit looks strong, liked streaming + function calling.
- 2025-11-17: POC kickoff using hosted_api; 3-week eval, ingestion of 120k docs, embeddings + reranking flow.
- 2025-12-01: POC interim check — 95th pct latency ~180ms for short queries, cost projections look high on hosted at scale.
- 2026-01-08: Demo of dedicated sizing options; discussed reserved pool model and autoscale bursts.
- 2026-02-26: Deep security review call (legal + security ops) — requested SOC2 + subprocessor list + KMS integration details (Priya on call). Fireflies ff_20260226_1437.
- 2026-03-02: Pricing + contract workshop with procurement, reviewed draft MSA & DPA (ff_20260302_0915). Procurement requested SLA tail-latency credits be clearer.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workload: low-latency QPS for in-product chat (target p50 ~50ms, p95 <200ms), reranking pipeline for search (batch embedding calls).
- Throughput: ~250 concurrent user sessions at peak, expected 1.5M tokens/day after launch.
- Model preference: open-model family (quantized) with option to route to higher-capacity variant for complex queries. Need ability to pin model versions.
- Routing: smart routing for region & cost; fallbacks acceptable to smaller quantized variant.

Procurement/legal specifics we are tracking:
- MSA redlines: Lakemont wants to narrow vendor indemnity scope, clarify IP ownership on derived outputs, and limit liability cap to 6 months ARR. AE note: Jordan proposed mutual indemnity language; legal to respond 2026-03-15.
- DPA: strict retention and deletion timelines for user PII; must include subprocessor disclosure and right to audit. Data residency for EU customers; default hosting in us-west with optional eu-west nodes.
- SLA: target 99.9% uptime; they want explicit token-level latency SLOs (p95 <=200ms) and credits for breaches. Need definition of measurement window.
- Security onboarding: SAML SSO, SCIM for provisioning, SOC2 attestation, KMS customer-managed key support (optional).

POC / Performance notes:
- Hosted proof: functional — search relevancy improved by ~18% on internal eval set. Cost estimate for hosted at 1.5M tokens/day projected ~ $18k/mo — they flagged as too high vs. dedicated priced quote.
- Dedicated quote: preliminary monthly reserved pool estimate provided (see Drive pricing deck). Estimated payback 6 months if 60% of traffic on dedicated.

Stakeholders / owners:
- Product lead: Aisha Verma (technical owner) — cares most about latency and model stability.
- Procurement: Tom Reyes — primary contact for contract negotiation.
- Security: Elena Park — vetting DPA and KMS.
- AE: Jordan Myers (owner). SE: Priya Nair. CSM: Marcus Lee (post-contract transition).

Quotes & customer color:
- "Love the model routing idea — we need deterministic fallbacks during incidents." — Aisha (01/08 demo)
- Procurement: "Need hard SLA + residency commitments before we commit to dedicated."

Next actions (short):
- Legal: send redline response to MSA by 2026-03-15 (Jordan).
- Security: deliver full subprocessor list + SOC2 report link (Priya to provide).
- Ops: schedule infra onboarding call to review VPC peering options for dedicated (week of 2026-03-22).

Open/risks:
- If MSA/DPA negotiations drag >30 days, risk they re-evaluate other vendors.
- Latency SLO measurement definition disagreement could slow SLA sign-off.

Attachments / refs: pricing deck (drive link), MSA draft v3 (drive link), Fireflies transcripts above, Jira INF tickets for POC infra asks.
